newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: GPG takes small stake in DB.
newsitem.headline: GPG takes small stake in DB.

text.p: Guinness Peat Group Ltd's New Zealand director Tony Gibbs on Friday ended weeks of speculation by confirming GPG had recently been acquiring a small holding in DB Group Ltd.
"We'll confirm that we are there. That's all I'm saying. I'm not giving any numbers but yes, I agree we have been buying and yes, we are there," Gibbs told Reuters.
"It's a good company," he said, adding the stake was acquired over the last month. The stake is understood to be around three or four percent.
DB Group, cashed up to the tune of around NZ$90 million, has beening mulling a capital restructure for some months and expects to present a proposal to shareholders at next year's annual meeting.
The liquor company's share price has been on a roll over the last month, opening today at NZ$0.97, equal to its high for the year. DB hit a low of NZ$0.78 on October 1.
DB Group is 59.8 percent owned by Asia Pacific Breweries Ltd, a venture between Heineken NV and Fraser and Neave Ltd
GPG is the investment vehicle of Sir Ron Brierley.
